aggregate_metrics._note: Why not accuracy: ~15% foreground → a background-only predictor gets ~85% accuracy. Dice/IoU focus on the foreground class and are appropriate for imbalanced segmentation.

aggregate_metrics_at_default_threshold_n._note: Why not accuracy: ~15% foreground → a background-only predictor gets ~85% accuracy. Dice/IoU focus on the foreground class and are appropriate for imbalanced segmentation.

caveat: Official FUSeg train and validation share patients; pHash only removes near-identical re-shots, so held-out scores may be optimistic relative to unseen patients.
